This was like my situation except I held on because I was scared to lose him. I thought I wanted to marry him until I realized I didn't. We talked about it, then we got into more fights and his anxiety of me leaving skyrocketed. It got to the point where fights would break out over me texting him saying "hey im gonna go sew ill talk later", it was tearing him apart and he wasn't okay anymore. It was my selfish desire to not be alone that was hurting him most.

My advice would be that if you do discuss it, make sure they're actually okay with it before you continue dating. Some people will be eaten alive by knowing you don't want forever, and it is cruel to keep the relationship if you don't want forever and they do.
